Florence Pugh Discusses 'East of Eden' Role and Series Reception

Actress Florence Pugh stated that her role in the miniseries 'East of Eden' contributed to her personal growth as an actress. Reviews for the series, particularly on Rotten Tomatoes, have been positive, with praise directed at the performances. The creator of 'East of Eden' commented on the emotional impact of adapting John Steinbeck's novel for Netflix, noting changes made to the original story.
